_comment: Central hash pin for the fixtures the B06/B08 runtime evidence depends on. These files are gitignored by policy and therefore absent from a clean checkout; this manifest is how a clean checkout can tell whether an operator-held copy is the one the evidence came from. Regenerate/verify: tools/phase4_b06_b08_pin_fixtures.py [--write]
_missing_bindings: start_state.sha256 is null in EVERY movie, so the format does not pin the state it was recorded against; neither the CPU execution mode nor the arm phase is recorded either. All three fail silently. This manifest pins the .sav hash itself, which is the binding the format lacks.
_oracle_status: As of 2026-08-01 both rows HAVE a cold-boot oracle: the two Phase4/*_from_boot movies are anchored to a power-on boot (from_boot true) and their full natural lifecycles are asserted, with no pokes, by tools/phase4_b06_b08_oracle.py. The remaining save-state fixtures are retained because they carry the perturbation runs (capacity refresh, cross-power transition, harvester intersection) that a natural playthrough cannot produce on demand.

B06_movie.json.purpose: Save-state anchored. Natural invincibility grant at frame 116821.

B08_movie.json.purpose: Save-state anchored. The R0-R5 perturbation runs: capacity refresh, cross-power transition, harvester intersection.

Phase4/B08_bubble_repeated_hits_from_boo.purpose: B08 COLD-BOOT ORACLE, LEVEL06 (scene 11). Natural collect -> 3 absorbs -> pop -> a contact that lands, and no tick touches the slot while it is negative. Asserted by tools/phase4_b06_b08_oracle.py --row b08.

Phase4/b06_invincibility_hits_from_boot..purpose: B06 COLD-BOOT ORACLE, LEVEL01 (scene 1). Natural collect -> contacts while active -> natural expiry -> a contact that lands. Asserted by tools/phase4_b06_b08_oracle.py --row b06. Recorded in a stage OTHER than the scene-11 Birdnest every earlier fixture used, so it also breaks the single-stage confinement.

b06_08_LEVEL13.movie.json.purpose: BREADTH FIXTURE, operator-recorded 2026-08-01. Level 13 = scene 9 = disc dir LEVEL09, a directory neither earlier fixture used. Both powers collected NATURALLY in one run: B06 grant 400 @f13513 with a full 400-tick countdown, B08 grant -3 @f14547 with all three absorbs to the pop, then damage lands. Format v4 with armed_while_paused=true, so the emulator applies the phase correction itself -- no rephase needed.
